id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

detailsSchemas.description:
Record of which name partitions exist for this run's {@link DataValidation.Run.Details} which can be accessed from
{@link #fetchDetails}.

ruleObj.description:
Field to retain all the information set by the rule. This will help us in:
1. Keeping the state of the rule at the time of creating the run.
2. Using the "snapshot" information to render the UX. (E.g ruleObj.detailsType)

argsOverride.description:
Any args to be passed for this run which will override (or add to) the existing arguments used in the rule. These
are passed during {@link DataValidation.Rule#initRun rule initialization}

args.description: All the args for the run which is based on the {@link DataValidation.Rule#args} with the {@link #argsOverride} applied.

runGroup.description:
Id denoting a runGroup (e.g a TimeWindow) as determined by {@link #rule} and {@link #args}. This group is very
important in determining if the run (or rule) has validation failure or not. (via {@link #status})

debugEnabled.description:
Switch on the debug mode for this run. This will be enabled when "debugEnabled" = true is passed in the
{@link #argsOverride} during {@link DataValidation.Rule#initRun rule initialization}. A {@link #debug} can be
used to add debug messages to the rule.

status.description: status of the run indicating whether it's in progress, finished or had an error.

duration.description: Duration for which this run went on

trigger.description: The trigger that resulted in the current run.

implRunId.description:
This contains the information about the action, job run, or workflow run that executed the Rule. Please
Note: It may be empty if the rule was triggered by any anomaly identified by platform during its
normal execution,which may be unrelated.

implRunKind.description:
Kind of the event / execution associated with the rule run. Please note that when the kind is an `ANOMALY`, there
may not be any "actual run" associated with this.
